# Hierarchical subject paths in participant role labels

Use dot-separated participant role references with the category first, the role last, and a subject path of arbitrary depth between them: `<category>.<subject>[.<subsubject>...].<role>`.

Do not impose a three-segment limit. The subject path may locate a role within a system, subsystem and deeper scope, for example `human.system.subsystem.maintainer` or `agent.case.requirements.author`.

Declare the meaning of the scope and role in the relevant document. The path does not itself assign a participant, grant authority or prove a structural relationship.

This extends the [earlier dot convention](programmatic-participants-and-category-first-labels.md); existing three-segment labels remain valid.
